hero.title: Hey, I'm Austin.
hero.highlight: I build ecommerce experiences that perform under pressure.
hero.summary: Senior front-end developer with deep ecommerce experience across Shopify, custom PHP platforms, checkout flows, product discovery, SEO, accessibility, and performance.

bio.title: Meet Austin
paragraphs: I'm a senior front-end developer strongest in ecommerce roles that need practical engineering, platform problem-solving, and clean translation of complicated business requirements into maintainable web tools.
My background spans custom PHP ecommerce systems, Shopify storefronts, React-based reusable tools, checkout experiences, product discovery, SEO, accessibility, and site speed work.

proofPoints.label: load-time reduction on one ecommerce store

homeExperience.summary: Led front-end work across automotive ecommerce sites, custom PHP platforms, Shopify storefronts, checkout flows, search, SEO, accessibility, and performance.
Built and maintained responsive websites, marketing pages, PHP and jQuery-based experiences, and ongoing content and troubleshooting workflows.
Providing front-end updates, PHP fixes, ecommerce improvements, performance cleanup, SEO fixes, and maintenance for small business web projects.

resumeExperience.summary: Led storefront development across custom PHP ecommerce systems and Shopify stores. Built reusable React and Liquid features, custom promotional tools, webhook-driven workflows, product discovery features with Bloomreach and Algolia, checkout experiences with Braintree, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, and performance work that reduced user-facing load time by roughly 9 seconds on one store.
bullets: Served as lead front-end developer for ecommerce storefronts spanning retail, wholesale, and B2B use cases.
Supported and modernized custom PHP-based ecommerce platforms for several years before helping transition key sites and workflows to Shopify.

Supported development across 8 Shopify stores during the company's Shopify migration period, maintaining storefront code, shipping new features, and helping keep platform work consistent across multiple brands.
Helped transition key ecommerce sites to Shopify through Liquid theme development, reusable storefront features, app block implementation, and storefront modernization.
Built React-based Shopify app functionality and internal tools that allowed reusable ecommerce features to be deployed across multiple stores instead of rebuilt store by store.
Developed custom discount and promotional tools to support business rules that were too specific for out-of-the-box platform behavior.
Built customer data workflows, webhook-driven tooling, custom admin pages, and storefront integrations for specialized B2B ecommerce needs.

Built and maintained product discovery features using Bloomreach and Algolia, including search interfaces, product listing behavior, recommendations, product placement, and analytics-focused merchandising tools.
Rebuilt checkout experiences used across multiple ecommerce stores, including Braintree-related work and Apple Pay / Google Pay support.

Improved site speed and front-end performance through script cleanup, asset-loading improvements, AMP support, and Core Web Vitals-focused optimizations; reduced user-facing load time by up to roughly 9 seconds on one ecommerce store.

Supported SEO, accessibility, and technical site-quality improvements, including structured data fixes, content placement, duplicate data cleanup, link/href improvements, and Google Merchant Center issue support.
Planned and supported A/B tests for checkout flows, product placement, UI changes, and conversion-focused experiments.
Established front-end workflow standards for GitHub usage, documentation, comments, file organization, and code review.
Managed one front-end developer for several years and later managed a front-end contractor for approximately three years while continuing hands-on development.

resumeExperience.summary: Designed, coded, modified, and maintained company websites and marketing-focused web experiences. Supported responsive UI, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, content updates, troubleshooting, and campaign pages for internal business teams.
bullets: Designed, coded, and modified websites based on business requirements, visual direction, and usability goals.
Built responsive, user-friendly web experiences with clear navigation and maintainable front-end structure.
Supported PHP, JavaScript, and jQuery-based websites across implementation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and content updates.
Partnered with internal teams to deliver web pages, campaign assets, and digital experiences for marketing and business needs.

resumeExperience.summary: Led daily support operations, maintained service quality and SLA standards, hired and trained staff, coordinated process improvements, and worked directly with clients and internal teams to resolve technical issues.
bullets: Managed daily support operations and helped maintain quality standards across the team.
Hired, trained, supervised, and supported staff in a technical client-service environment.
Coordinated support projects and helped introduce process improvements, tooling, and operational standards.
Worked directly with clients and internal teams to resolve technical issues and improve support consistency.

Ticket Rumba: BigCommerce front-end development from provided designs with Stencil, LESS, CMS work, and KeenIO-related analytics support.
Freelance web work: maintenance, technical fixes, ecommerce improvements, SEO cleanup, and small business website support.
